jordan_support: Customer reported rerank returning uniformly high scores (~0.98) after swapping their embedding model to embed-text-small. They attached an example payload.

jordan_support: ```json
{
  "user_id": "acct-554",
  "embed_model": "embed-text-small",
  "rerank_model": "redwood-rerank-v1",
  "queries": ["what is our refund policy"],
  "candidates": ["refunds processed within 30 days", "pricing tiers", "how to contact support"]
}
```

amanda_se: Can you paste the exact /v1/rerank call (headers + payload)? Also which embed model did they use before? :thinking:

jordan_support: They switched from embed-text-XL (1536) -> embed-text-small (1024). Rerank call body:

```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "redwood-rerank-v1",
  "query_embedding": [/* 1024 floats */],
  "candidate_embeddings": [[/* 1024 floats */],[/* 1024 floats */]]
}
```

ryan_ml: This is almost surely an embedding-dimension mismatch. redwood-rerank-v1 expects 1536-d embeddings (trained on that space). If you send 1024-d vectors, our current code was silently padding/truncating which can distort cosine similarity and produce near-1 scores.

ryan_ml: Short repro I ran locally: took random 1024 vectors, server padded to 1536 with zeros then normalized -> many pairs end up with high cosine because normalization changes distribution. Not good.

sara_runtime: We should add strict validation: if rerank model metadata says embedding_dim != len(request.embedding) return 400 with message: "embedding_dim_mismatch: expected 1536, got 1024; please use compatible embedding model or convert embeddings." I'll schedule a stats/metric for these 400s.

amanda_se: Jordan, can you get a minimal curl repro (query + 2 candidates) and the customer's account id so we can test on Dedicated? Also include sample raw embeddings so we don't have to re-embed.

jordan_support: Pasted curl and embeddings (sanitized) below; account acct-554. Repro steps: 1) generate embeddings with embed-text-small for query + candidates, 2) call /v1/rerank with redwood-rerank-v1, 3) observe scores ~0.95-0.99 across all.

ryan_ml: I'll open a PR to add the server-side validation + clear error message and a short note in the docs about model pairing. For now tell customer to either: (a) re-run embeddings with embed-text-XL, or (b) use rerank-v1-lite (1536->? we don't have lite) — so (a) is recommended. Offer a temporary workaround: we can project 1024->1536 using provided PCA map if they need, but that requires coordination (not immediate).

sara_runtime: I'll patch runtime to emit a metric and return 400. Plan: rollback-safe patch, deploy next minor release, add a feature flag.

amanda_se: I'll draft a customer message and offer a service credit for the churn risk. Jordan can you send the customer the repro explanation + recommended fix?

jordan_support: Sending now. Customer replied thanks and will re-run with embed-text-XL. Marking as escalated->resolved once we deploy validation. :white_check_mark:

billing-bot: Note: offered 2 hours of dedicated support credit to acct-554 (internal ticket #INC-8932).

ryan_ml: Follow-up: we should also add a linter in SDKs to warn when pairing known incompatible embed+rerank combos.

sara_runtime: Agreed. Adding to next sprint.
